timingAndDisclosure: Written AFTER the sole producer completed. The independent finding was derived from source text only, without producer-output inspection by R2 or comparator author V1. This is not a preproducer policy and does not establish that the original policy passed unchanged.

clarifications.rule: Each successful enclosing snapshot has error:null. Each checks[k] has exactly ordered own keys planIndex,post,verified; no error or pre key. post has exactly ordered rgbaSha256,maskSha256, equals enclosing snapshot.pre, and verified is true. Ten checks retain exact plan order. Missing is not null; never inject a key into a trace.

Compressed provenance prose is interpreted by the exact source object type, not by fabricating every listed field on every entry. Each physical source closure has ordered verified,entries; its nine entries have exactly ordered path,expectedSha256,actualSha256,error, expected equals actual and error:null. Each implementation list has five entries with exactly ordered path,expectedSha256,actualSha256,bytes; no error or per-entry verified field. First two expectedSha256 are literal null as source emits; their actual hashes are checked against the independently frozen source admission. Remaining three expected digests match actual. Every byte count and path remains exact and independently bound. Across before/after stages and across runs all these entries remain exact.
